payload.summary: OpenCut Classic shares the existing Editor Agent Sign in with ChatGPT vault, account-bound model and effort preferences, and public Responses API across eligible text features. Legacy login endpoints return 410. Production Electron uses a main-frame-scoped external sign-in handoff to an exact OpenAI URL and the loopback callback. Existing image artifacts recover, while new subscription image jobs stop because the documented route does not support them. The public web host cannot access the local subscription connection. Official Anthropic docs authorize the user signing in to the unmodified CLI and require approval or API-key credentials for the requested third-party provider. No Claude account credentials or CLI requests are routed by OpenCut. Web tests 66 passed, Electron tests 9 passed, production target and Windows packaging passed. Configured DIP verification was rejected as unsupported project schema.
